applications.revokeConfirm: Revoking access removes {{name}}'s app key from your wallet and revokes the storage access it was granted. For each collection it provisioned, the encryption key is rotated so anything written from now on is unreadable to it -- but it may still hold copies of data it already fetched. The app will need to connect again from scratch. Older connections without a revocable grant will lapse on their own. This cannot be undone.
